load_dataset_samples: load all stereo pointmap render people samples from the data root directory into a data list
get_data_info_pair: get a pair of data info dicts for a sample and a random other sample from the same mesh
extract_bbox_from_mask: extract bounding box coordinates from a segmentation mask using row and column analysis
load_camera_intrinsics: load camera intrinsics matrix K and extrinsics matrix M from text files for a sample
register_dataset_module: register the StereoPointmapRenderPeopleDataset class with the mmseg DATASETS registry for use in segmentation pipelines
